_coverage_rationale: REF-DEAL-5: Clean historical actuals + forward forecast in same XLSX workbook. Tests the system's ability to correctly distinguish historical actuals (high confidence) from forward projections (medium), select actuals as current_state.revenue, and not let future-year rows contaminate current-state. This is the scenario the existing 4 deals never fully exercise: DealDecision is proforma-only; WebMax is a single-year scenario; StackFactor has projections but no actuals; Qredible is deck-only. No deal in the set has both verifiable historical actuals AND a multi-year forecast in the same workbook.
_failure_modes_targeted: Compiler promoting a future-year XLSX row over the most-recent-actual row (period confusion)
Extraction treating 'FY2025 Actual' and 'FY2026 Budget' identically instead of tagging period_type differently
Revenue regression: actuals row suppressed by noise guard because its period_label matches a guard pattern
Burn rate computed from budget/forecast total expenses instead of actual total expenses — overstating efficiency
Scale confusion when actuals are in $000s and forecast is in whole dollars (or vice versa)
Gross-margin contradiction: actuals show 45% but forecast shows 80% — compiler must not blend them
